reviewer_independence: Performed by a separate evidence-audit agent that did not implement or edit the candidate source.
scope: Frozen one-process, 32-tenant, volatile-recovery embedded-v3 workload only.

dependency_facts.direct_runtime: wasmtime 46.0.1 with default features disabled and only cranelift,runtime
dependency_facts.scheduler: tokio 1.53.1 multi-thread runtime with four worker threads

checks.evidence: Each tenant owns a bounded Tokio channel and a separate tenant task. Tenant execution is not protected by a global execution lock; only the required single NDJSON writer is globally serialized.
checks.observation: Synchronous Wasmtime calls execute on the four Tokio workers. A CPU-hog call occupies one worker until the shared epoch ticker interrupts it, so broader simultaneous blocking-host-call fairness is outside this review.

checks.evidence: One shared Engine compiles the four core Modules once into ArtifactCatalog. Per-tenant creation instantiates a Store and Instance from a cloned Module handle; rollout prepares only one replacement instance per target.

SharedRuntime creates one Engine and one 1 ms epoch ticker. Each tenant has one Store with StoreLimits of 10 MiB, one instance, and one memory. No Engine-per-message or Module-per-command path exists.

The adapter uses maintained Wasmtime and Tokio primitives directly. No maintained crate was identified that supplies the frozen incarnation, idempotency, bounded-admission, recovery, and transactional-rollout contract without equivalent adapter code.
production_linker exposes only the comparison ABI. authority_absent_at_link verifies the probe-specific first import and requires an exact unknown-import instantiation failure.
Trap and CPU-deadline failures replace only the target tenant instance, advance the oracle-owned incarnation, reset volatile counter and idempotency state, and leave sibling tenant tasks independent.

The coordinator prepares every target before settlement. It commits all prepared replacements only after all preparations pass and discards all prepared replacements after any failure; settlement failure becomes InDoubt.

known_limitations: The unbounded tenant control channel is safe under the frozen oracle's serialized control traffic but is not a general bounded-control-plane guarantee.
Update state transfer is the frozen guest's counter through restore_counter, not arbitrary linear-memory or resource migration.
The review does not establish scheduler fairness for multiple simultaneous CPU hogs or blocking host calls.
Passing this static review is permission to run the frozen experiment, not evidence that its dynamic gates or SLOs pass.
